entries.08041e665db31b87: The company and its 5 consolidated subsidiaries (Daido Denko Co., Ltd., Daido Signal Denki Co., Ltd., Daido Signal Kako Co., Ltd., Daido Techno Service Co., Ltd. and Sankosha Co., Ltd.), 6 companies in total, form the group and conduct railway signaling-related business, industrial equipment-related business and real estate-related business.
entries.33637261aba9837f: In this business the company manufactures and sells information and communication equipment, while its subsidiary Sankosha Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells traffic signal equipment, railway vehicle supplies, gas detectors and other products, and Daido Signal Kako Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells plastic molded products, metal surface treatment and molds. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,330 million.
